name: RIDL
impact: Rogue In-Flight Data Load samples stale data from Intel microarchitectural fill buffers after a faulting load, leaking data across address spaces and out of SGX enclaves
mitigation: Intel microcode updates (MDS mitigations) and disabling SMT for cross-hyperthread protection
boundary_statement: RIDL (Rogue In-Flight Data Load, MDS) shares CVE-2018-12130 with ZombieLoad: both names refer to Microarchitectural Fill Buffer Data Sampling. Intel SGX is not a platform in this taxonomy, so no platform is tagged.

INTENT.evidence: Red Hat MDS advisory: CVE-2018-12130 'is referred to by researchers as RIDL or ZombieLoad', confirming that the two names share one CVE.
